photos.c: P. NEWELL hands over to C. WALKER after doing 5th fastest time on stage 3.
Jack Brown takes over from Pat Newell to start Stage four in second place
Gerry North hands over to Pat Newell
BOTTOM LEFT: Pat Newell about to past Tony Milner of Walton on stage 10.
TOP LEFT: Pat Newell, closely followed by Palmer of Blackpool.

The Brighton in PHOTOS: TOP LEFT: Pat Newell takes the baton from Bill Kerr to set off on Stage 10 with a 2 minutes lead. TOP RIGHT: Laurie O'Hara gives Gerry North the lead we all hoped for---46 secs over Portsmouth after 7 stages. John Davies, behind, takes a time-check. CENTRE LEFT: That long stretch of empty road behind Gerry North lengthens with every stride. CENTRE RIGHT:Bill Kerr clocks fastest time on Stage 9---the longest at 6 miles-52 yards. BOTTOM LEFT: The picture Eddie Lacey has waited 22 'Brightons' for---Belgrave crossing the line 3mins-10secs ahead of Portsmouth. BOTTOM RIGHT:Alan Black hands the presentation baton to the Mayor of Brighton Councillor S.D. Deason J.P. Photos by E.D.L. & R.L.

THE WINNING LONDON-BRIGHTON RELAY TEAM (Southern Event) ON THE SEA-FRONT WITH THE PRESIDENT AND THE "NEWS OF THE WORLD" TROPHY. REAR:(L.toR.) P. Newell, W.Kerr,Geoff.North,R.Linstead,The President, A.Fairclough,B.Sawyer,C. Dabbs. FRONT:(L.toR.)J.Thresher,Gerald North,L.O'Hara,A. Black. (C.W. Walker was not present).
Don trails Mal Robinson and Pat Newall at the half distance in the 1961 Belgrave mile championship. Don was beaten on the tape by John Davies, with Newall 3rd and Robinson 4th.

Below: Belgrave vets before the start of the Surrey Vets' CC Champ. at Richmond Park, 19th October.
Standing: John Wasbrough, Charlie Walker, Alan Lane, Rex Bale, Keith Duckett, Mark Hutton, Tony Stone, Derek Manning, Dudley Gordon.
Kneeling: Paul King, Arthur Bruce, Leo Coy, Frank Barrett, Charlie Dickinson, Mike Newton, Pat Newall and Harry Porter.

Below: Belgrave's second placing M60 team from the BVAF National Cross Country Championships at Burnley - Pat Newell, Bert Stroud and Charlie Walker. When this trio get together with our other M60 hero Laurie O'Hara - watch out world.
Above: Pat Newell nears the end of the Belgrave 10k on October 24th where he clocked up 38:23 for first M60.
